definitions.explanation: Describes speech or language ability that is smooth and natural, without hesitation or awkwardness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{流暢|りゅうちょう}な⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
{流暢|りゅうちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised by the foreigner who spoke Japanese fluently.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{流暢|りゅうちょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It's been three years since I went abroad to study, but I still can't say I'm fluent.

notes:
A na-adjective describing smooth, natural speech without hesitation. Almost exclusively used about language ability.

FORMS:
- {流暢|りゅうちょう}な + noun: {流暢|りゅうちょう}な⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧ (fluent English)
- {流暢|りゅうちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb: {流暢|りゅうちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (to speak fluently)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {流暢|りゅうちょう}な⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧: fluent Japanese
- {流暢|りゅうちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to speak fluently
- {流暢|りゅうちょう}な⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧: fluent pronunciation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ペラペラ: fluent (casual, onomatopoeic — ペラペラ⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧)
- ⟦{堪能|たんのう}→堪能：12081_tannou⟧: proficient, skilled (broader — not limited to speaking)

{流暢|りゅうちょう} focuses specifically on speaking smoothness and is more formal than ペラペラ.
